reviewNotes: Descriptions starting with 'CHECK:' describe code behaviour that may not be what was intended, or a limit that was a judgment call. Confirm or correct each, then set reviewed to true.

Which settings inside 'Delivery settings' are required depends on the delivery method (the allOf/if rules at the bottom of schema): every method needs Current; staircase also needs MaxTrials, MinValue, MaxValue, StepSize, NUp and FastStart; numberErrors needs Nerrors; fixed needs MaxTrials.

Not added: Instructions01-05Audio/Time, InstructionsSpoken and RecordGIF. The scan found them in CommonParts.js, but Digit Span's timeline never uses those parts (it has its own instruction pages and records no drawing).

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Order in which the participant must report the digits. Also selects which instruction pages are shown.

oneOf.title: Forward: repeat the digits in the order presented
Backward: repeat the digits in reverse order

StimulusMode.title: How digits are presented
StimulusMode.description: Audio digits are preloaded from the instruction set's FolderOfAudioFiles. Audio: each digit plays in a 1.5 s slot. Visual: each digit is shown for 1 s, then a 0.5 s blank. Those timings are fixed in the task code and config/DigitSpan_Setup.js, not set here.

oneOf.title: Visual: digits are shown on screen

DeliveryMethod.title: How list length changes
DeliveryMethod.description: Controls how many digits each trial has and when the task stops. The settings each method uses are listed under 'Delivery settings'.

oneOf.title: Staircase: adaptive; longer after correct runs, shorter after errors; stops after Max trials
Number of errors: two trials per length, then one digit longer; stops after N errors in a row
Fixed start: starts at Starting length, adds one digit every trial; stops after Max trials

Parameters.title: Delivery settings
Parameters.description: Settings for the chosen delivery method. Each field says which methods use it; the others ignore it.

Current.title: Starting length (digits)
Current.description: Number of digits in the first trial. All methods. Digits 1-9 are used without repeats up to 9 digits; longer lists repeat digits. CHECK: maximum 20 is a judgment call.

MaxTrials.title: Max trials
MaxTrials.description: Staircase and Fixed start: the task stops after this many trials. Number of errors ignores it (it stops on errors instead).

MinValue.title: Shortest length (digits)
MinValue.description: Staircase only: the list never gets shorter than this.

MaxValue.title: Longest length (digits)
MaxValue.description: Staircase only: the list never gets longer than this. Number of errors has no upper limit. CHECK: should Number of errors also stop at a maximum length?

StepSize.title: Step size (digits)
StepSize.description: Staircase only: digits added after a correct run, or removed after an error. Number of errors always adds 1, whatever this says.

NUp.title: Correct in a row to get longer
NUp.description: Staircase only: after the fast start ends, this many correct trials in a row make the list one step longer.

NDown.title: Errors in a row to get shorter
NDown.description: CHECK: has no effect. The staircase code makes the list one step shorter after every error, whatever this value is.

FastStart.title: Fast start
FastStart.description: Staircase only: until the first error, every correct trial makes the list longer (NUp is ignored until then).

Nerrors.title: Errors in a row to stop
Nerrors.description: Number of errors only: the task stops after this many incorrect trials in a row. CHECK: the count runs across lengths, so failing the second trial at 5 digits and the first at 6 counts as 2 in a row.

MaxReversals.title: Max reversals
MaxReversals.description: CHECK: has no effect. The Digit Span task never checks this stopping rule (config comment: 'Not implemented').

MaxTime.title: Max time (s)
MaxTime.description: CHECK: has no effect. Not implemented in the staircase code (config comment: 'Not implemented').

ShowWelcome.title: Show welcome page
ShowWelcome.description: Show the welcome page (from the instruction set) before the task.

WelcomeSpoken.title: Speak the welcome
WelcomeSpoken.description: Only applies when the welcome is shown: play the welcome audio with a Repeat button and a 4 s progress bar. Needs a Welcome audio file.

WelcomeAudio.title: Welcome audio file
WelcomeAudio.description: Path to the welcome audio. Only used when 'Speak the welcome' is Yes. Existing files: assets/SoundFiles/Instructions/Welcome_DigitSpanForward.wav and assets/SoundFiles/Instructions/Welcome_DigitSpanBackard.wav (spelled 'Backard'). CHECK: no existing Digit Span set uses the spoken welcome yet.

ShowInstructions.title: Show instructions
ShowInstructions.description: Show the instruction pages for the chosen presentation and direction (e.g. Audio + Backward) before the first trial.

AskForNotes.title: Ask for examiner notes
AskForNotes.description: After the last trial, show a free-text box for notes about the session.

ShowThankYou.title: Show thank-you page
ShowThankYou.description: Show the thank-you page (from the instruction set) at the end.
